entities.name: Supervoid
entities.description: A singularity ringed in a photon collar, different from a true black hole; one thousand have been made or found by Monoists.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: Faith that creates and reveres supervoids.

entities.name: Monasteriat
entities.description: Congress of monks administering Monoist doctrine from the Lip of Susur.

entities.name: Lip of Susur
entities.description: Capital of the Monoist faith, the photon collar ringing Point Prime.

entities.name: Point Prime
entities.description: First and most holy supervoid of the Monoist faith.

entities.name: Immortal Faller
entities.description: Figure observed approaching the center of every supervoid.

entities.name: INEVITA
entities.description: The promised future beyond the Zero Point.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: Star system that the Monoists collapsed into a supervoid.

entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: Enemy of the Monoists in the Entropy War.

entities.name: Entropy War
entities.description: War between the Monoists and the Celestial Palatinate.

entities.name: Sekhar
entities.description: A bead that causes singularity induction.

events.summary: The Monoists collapse the star Sothera into a supervoid using sekhar.
events.quote: The Monoists caused it to instead collapse in on itself into a supervoid

events.summary: The Celestial Palatinate fights to re-ignite Sothera with horizon javelins.
events.quote: the Celestial Palatinate fights them to instead re-ignite the star

relations.note: Fight over Sothera in the Entropy War.
relations.quote: The Sothera system is a pivotal front in the Entropy War with the Celestial Palatinate .
The Monasteriat is a congress of monks who administer Monoist doctrine
